final_message: Mechanism chain is complete: the checker binds the condition value to its producing call, requires the goto target's cleanup region to free a member of a struct pointer passed to that failing call, and gates locally-initialized fields on a callee-body ownership release, so the vulnerable 'goto free_fc' path warns at kfree(mt->fc) (callee already frees it) while the fixed 'goto free_match_hl' retarget removes that free from the failing path's cleanup region and stays silent; only functional-validation risk remains.
